annotations.text:
Pass 1 of 3 — foundations only.
No product screens here: pass 2 draws the phone screens and pass 3 the desktop ones, both built entirely from what is on this canvas.

Every value shown is deliberately fake, in the formats the build already uses.

Brand-swappable: the accent ramp and the wordmark, nothing else.

The accent is a tweak on the Tokens artboard — change it there to see the ramp, the primary button and the focus ring move together.

Component names are the contract.
CapturePanel, ClarityConfirm, VoicePanel, DiagramPanel and PushPanel are the build's own names, kept deliberately. Passes 2 and 3 reference every name on this page verbatim rather than inventing a parallel vocabulary.

A screen that needs a state not on this page is a gap to bring back here, not a one-off to draw in place.

Three things on this page are new surface, not a restyling of something that exists:

· Sign out — there is no such control anywhere in the build today.
· PhoneNav — navigation exists only on the admin screens.
· PushIndicator — the API already returns the value; nothing renders it.
One sheet to check a screen against. If a variant is on a screen in pass 2 or 3 and not on this sheet, one of the two is wrong.
